title: AC1024 value-dependency handle-code census and schema conflict

scope.purpose: Record the physical handle-code observations, compare them with available source schemas, and identify what remains unproven before physical profile admission.

audit.projection: For each OBJECTS record whose decoded object class is ASSOCVALUEDEPENDENCY, collect the first element of assocdep.dep_on, assocdep.readdep, assocdep.node, and assocdep.dep_body.
audit.result: The three JSON projections agree on observed decoded values. This is a census of one peer reader's interpretation, not independent proof of semantic field roles or source byte offsets.

conflictingSchema.dwgSchema: src/dwg2.spec:1874-1881 declares the ACDBASSOCDEPENDENCY base handle sequence as 3/4/3/4 for dep_on/readdep/node/dep_body.
conflictingSchema.dxfMapping: src/in_dxf.c:6619, 6625-6627 maps those same fields with codes 3/4/3/4.
conflictingSchema.memoryLayoutCaveat: include/dwg.h:6322-6328 declares dep_body before node in the C struct; that in-memory order is not evidence of DWG wire order.
conflictingSchema.interpretation: The empirical peer JSON values and the peer's schema constants disagree. The schema source is not an independent semantic authority and does not resolve the physical field-to-code mapping.

oda.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files, v5.4.1
oda.finding: Generic code 3 denotes hard ownership and code 4 denotes a soft pointer. The inspected section does not establish the ACDBASSOCVALUEDEPENDENCY field-to-code sequence.
oda.effect: Generic meanings alone cannot resolve the observed/schema conflict.

implementation.summary: The current AC1024 ACDBASSOCVALUEDEPENDENCY reader checks the observed 4/4/4/3 code tuple. A mismatch leaves parsed fields readable but marks the dependency wire incomplete; all body, string, and handle spans must also satisfy the existing bounded-padding check.
implementation.qualification: This is a conservative provisional parser guard. The observed tuple does not qualify the class-specific semantic roles, physical suffix spans, or output profile.

focusedTests.result: PASS 3/3. The vector selector verifies acceptance of the observed tuple and field retention with wire-incomplete status on a mismatched tuple.

limitations: The code census does not resolve whether the field roles or offsets assigned by the peer JSON correspond to the authoritative physical schema.
The physical value-dependency body/text/handle suffixes remain incompletely decoded and bounded.
The mechanical ACDBASSOCVARIABLE suffix remains unresolved.
The physical samples are local investigation inputs and were not added as repository fixtures.
No output support claim is promoted; strict physical export remains refused.

planImpact.completedScopeRemovedFromQueue: The 77-record peer handle-code census across the three local AC1024 sources is complete and recorded here.
planImpact.remainingP4Scope: Resolve the field-role/code disagreement using authoritative layout and offset evidence; decode and bound body/text/handle spans; then qualify required owners, descendants, emitted fields, and readback. The mechanical ACDBASSOCVARIABLE suffix also remains open.
